mapper.select: SELECT q.q_no, q.q_title, q.q_date, q.q_content, q.q_secret, q.m_no, m.m_nickname FROM question q LEFT JOIN member2 m ON m.m_no = q.m_no ORDER BY q.q_no DESC
SELECT q.q_no, q.q_title, q.q_date, q.q_content, q.q_secret, q.m_no, m.m_nickname FROM question q LEFT JOIN member2 m ON m.m_no = q.m_no WHERE q.q_no = #{q_no}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question(q_no, q_title, q_date, q_content, q_secret, m_no) VALUES( 'Q' || LPAD(QUESTION_SEQ.NEXTVAL, 5, '0'), #{q_title}, SYSDATE, #{q_content}, NVL(#{q_secret}, 'N'), #{m_no} )
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET q_title = #{q_title}, q_date = SYSDATE, q_content = #{q_content}, q_secret = NVL(#{q_secret}, 'N') WHERE q_no = #{q_no}
